cycle_definition: start position (authored phase range_[0]) -> straight-arm pull to authored phase range_[1] -> turnaround -> optional hold -> full return to range_[0]; the pull and return follow the published viewer ease, each lever segment snapped up to whole 20 ms samples

handle_down.description: preparation at the pulled turnaround, then one monotonic non-returning set-down to the start position and stillness; no pull at all

reference: authored model phase and explicit exercise cycle only; no detector output, threshold, axis sign or peak
